title: Simla Special
desc: Two friends, Gopu and Babu, own a troupe that performs comedic plays. When Babu faces a financial crisis, the two friends decide to accept a commission and perform for the Tamilians in Shimla.

title: Vaitheeswaran
desc: After the death of Saravanan, a sage tells his mother that her son will reincarnate if she never leaves the temple and prays. Thirty years later, an agnostic Dr Bala meets the mother to treat her.

title: Vaidehi Kathirunthal
desc: Vaidehi, a widow and Vellaisamy, a homeless man, undergo a drastic turn in their lives as they join forces to save a young couple from the fury of the villagers.

title: Jackson Durai
desc: Sathya, a policeman, and Veera, a relative of Viji, must spend a night in the village's infamous haunted bungalow as a challenge when they both fall for Viji and try to seek her approval.

title: Thiruttu Payale
desc: A wilful man blackmails a married woman, Roopini, after recording a video of her with another man. However, Roopini leaves no stone unturned to outwit him.
